name: Identity
need: A person as one glance — avatar beside name and secondary line — was being hand-rolled per screen: the showcase's UsersPage built it this morning, a second app built it earlier (the deferred EntityCell candidate). Second use is the trigger, and the research rule is firm: a person is recognised face-beside-name, never face floating a row above it.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: The face without the name is a decoration; the unit is what reads.
That is many people as presence; this is one person as identity.

proposedApi.Identity: name (ReactNode — a card passes its CardTitle), avatarName for the Avatar fallback when name is rich, secondary (role OR email, one), src, size sm | md | lg, vertical for the one profile-hero case (never lists)

sources: Fluent 2 Persona (fixed line order, sizes drop lines); showcase UsersPage + a second app users card
decision: Build; UsersPage adopts it in the same batch. A second app adopts at next feature touch (its repo).
decidedBy: owner (2026-08-21, approved the content catalogue plan)
